server day 14: Use your selectors. Novice recruitment closed after server day 14 on the NA relaunch server. Unlimited Recruitment may follow your account age; check its timer.
server days 15-15: Shop: Juzo [CCG Maverick], Hinami [Fledgling Butterfly]. Shop entries are real; which shop and price aren't in the data [check in game: shop currency].

server days 30-30: Hero level cap 200. [game data]
server days 33-33: Strategic Arena matchmaking starts (it unlocks from day 15 at Chain Depth 120; level, limit and gear are made equal, star rating and refinement carry over). [game data]

what: If you spend at all: only inside a rebate window
detail: You don't have to spend. If you do, buy inside a rebate window. A rebate window makes each purchase pay twice. The best one is the Diamond Rebate, server days 34–55. Plain Diamonds are the worst value: 80 per $1 (October 19 price).

detail: So the Starter and Mid teams use units you can really own and upgrade. An S unit you can't get, or can't star up, doesn't help your team. Free player? Read banner units at "At 0★" and shop units at "At full stars".

what: Faction order after the first team
detail: No Org first: the cheapest. Nutcracker came from the days 1–7 Wish Rebate (now closed), and the free No Org units all power her up. Aogiri second, once your first team is complete: your second guild-war team, and the only team for Formidable Noro. CCG third: three bosses take 30% more from CCG, and Kureo is free. Anteiku last: creators call it "struggling" after the October 14 patch, and its free units are not a real team.

Sign-in units by server day: Enji (day 1), Yakumo [Jason] (day 5), Kureo (day 9), Kurona (day 13). Sen: Unlimited Recruitment, in your first 14 days after you register. Rize [Binge Eater]: free mission chain.

what: Global Pinnacle: 5 teams on forced auto
detail: Plan: Build 5 teams: fights are 5 against 5, best of 5, on forced auto.
Join an active organization on day 1. Only the top 8 organizations in that week's Weekly Challenge can enter guild war.
Bring attributes that beat the boss: STR beats SKL, SKL beats SPD, SPD beats STR. Merge skill cards to Lv3 before you cast. Stun and full Weak stop counters; Disruption does not.
Level only your main team (5–6 units, back-up included). A second copy (1★) is the best upgrade: it unlocks the second passive. Put Limit Crystals into your main carry.

what: Pick one faction and build its strongest team first
detail: Pick one faction and build its strongest team first. No Org is the cheapest start.
Play Chain Campaign. Save Diamonds until you know which banner you will finish.
If the shop sells them, buy Uta [Rescue] (day 43) first, then Hideyoshi (day 75). Check the shop tabs every week.
Sign-in units by server day: Enji (day 1), Yakumo [Jason] (day 5), Kureo (day 9), Kurona (day 13). Day-14 SSR Selection Card: take Naki [Crybaby]. Day-28 card: Shu [Gourmet].

name: Diamond Spring exchange; amount: About +520 a day per exchange; note: Stake 500. The 24-hour option returns 1,020 on average, the 48-hour option 1,315. If a running 48-hour exchange blocks your daily slot, collecting every 24 hours pays more; creators say to always pick 48 hours, so check in game. Creators report 1,200 to 2,500 back on the 48-hour option, and one says it was cut to 1,200–1,500 (creator report). You get 1 exchange a day at VIP 0; one creator says the second needs VIP 5, another says VIP 7, so check your VIP screen.; source: October 19 article "Pull and spend" (game data); creator videos Aslan (May 14 and October 25, 2026), Shi (April 27, 2026), Zeketta (April 23, 2026)…
Start from a line-up on Best teams. Use 4 on the field plus 1 back-up. The back-up only uses passives marked "[Effective also in back-up state]". One character can't be in two teams.
Tip: Half-cost Stamina on new servers (days 1-28) covers Biography.

One creator reached VIP 6 with the monthly login contract plus growth funds, and says to stop at VIP 5: it adds sweeps and, by his account, the second Diamond Spring exchange (about +520 a day). Another creator puts that exchange at VIP 7, so check the VIP screen before you top up for it. (creator report) Big spenders: creators name no perk worth chasing between VIP 9 and 13; VIP 19 and up adds avatar borders and much bigger daily Limit Crystal mail. (creator report)

unlock: From the start why: Its Depth unlocks other modes (Assignments, World Boss at Depth 15, Unlimited Recruitment milestones) and raises idle-farm income. After Auto-Battle unlocks, spend Chain Licenses (1 per battle; they reset to 10 daily at 05:00).

what: Why No Org for free players
detail: Pick one faction and stay with it. Free-to-play: No Organization is the cheapest. Nutcracker came from the days 1–7 Wish Rebate (now closed), Sen is free, and the free No Org units all power her up.

what: Why you end up needing 3 teams
detail: 3. After Encounter begins, each player needs to use 3 lineups to fight the enemy 3 times 4. Once a lineup is used in a battle, the Characters in the lineup cannot be deployed in other lineups in the same round of Encounter. The Carnival Arena is a special arena that requires 3 teams to play a best-of-3 format.
